Multi-purpose extra-long tweezers designed for succulent hobbyists. Strong and durable. Perfectly aligned curved tip. Ideal for creating miniature projects, transferring and planting small succulent propagations to new pots, making compact arrangements with ease. Can be used to groom plants by removing dead leaves. Long enough to access hard-to-reach areas without disturbing nearby delicate leaves. Made of the best quality stainless steel. Manufactured by a company that supplies surgical and dental instruments. The green coating will not peel off or fade.
